messages:
Anika: Draft is up for an internal preview — final pass on the product launch blog + webinar/demo sequence. Target publish Wed 9:00am PT. Need legal quick-check, sales demo capacity, design hero alt text, and inbound lead routing map. @Maya @Rory @Katie @Josh please.

Maya: On it. Quick callout — the benchmark table needs a short note about testbed (A100 v4, seq=512). Also let's avoid an exact p95 latency number until the bench audit is finished.

Josh: I'll prep HubSpot form + webhook. Which form ID should I use? Need final UTM params to align with the webinar and nurture flows.

Rory: Sales can cover 2 concurrent live demos during the webinar. We need to tag 'high-touch' leads and route them to the SDR queue immediately. Recommend CTA opens pre-filled booking link so attendees can reserve a slot.

Katie: Hero image uploaded to Figma — alt text suggestion: 'Redwood inference dashboard on laptop'. Also uploaded a 1200x600 crop for social. Small caption looks better on mobile.

LegalBot: Quick-pass: remove the phrasing 'guaranteed 5x cost savings'. Please replace with 'typical observed cost reductions' and add the citation link to the Optimize report. Otherwise OK.

Anika: Thanks. Josh — putting the UTM block here so we stay consistent:
```
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=organic
utm_campaign=dedicated-launch-webinar
utm_content=hero-cta
```
Also add `?ref=insider` for early-preview emails.

Josh: Got it. I'll provision form id `mkt_dedicated_2024` and webhook to `/webhooks/lead-ingest`. Field mapping: email, name, company, role, interest_tags. I'll also ensure HubSpot sets a lifecycle stage and adds the `interest:dedicated` tag on ingest.

Rory: I'll coordinate demo hardware with ops — need 2x RTX-class nodes reserved for the live demos. @eng-sre can you confirm capacity? Also prepping an RSVP Google sheet for handoffs.

Maya: I'll update the benchmark captions and include a small legend explaining test conditions. Will swap the p95 line to 'observed p95 during internal tests' until audit is done.

Katie: Noted on image sizes — uploaded Twitter/OG variants and updated the figma file with alt and caption options.

Anika: Final checks: Legal ok with revised phrasing. Plan: canary publish Wed 9:00am PT (site-only), full audience push + webinar email at 11:00am PT. If all green I'll mark Asana task 4219 as 'publish ready'.

Josh: :thumbsup: I'll queue the email and HubSpot nurture for 11:00am PT and watch lead ingestion. Please paste the live post URL in the thread when it's up so I can confirm UTM patches.

Rory: Sales team on standby for demo handoff and followups. I'll drop the pre-filled calendar link and RSVP sheet once Ops confirms hardware.

Anika: Thanks all — locking publish window and tagging ready in Asana. Moving thread to 'publish ready'. :party-parrot:
